bluf: Portent is a defunct Seattle integrated digital marketing agency, founded in 1995, which the record says its holdco parent Clearlink closed in May 2024; Wallaroo Media now serves many former clients and maintains portent.com. What survives is a record of what it sold, SEO first, then content and digital PR and PPC, and a five client case book. Horus reads Exposed at negative 24.6, the read of a mix that no longer trades; Monsoon reads Onshore wind at 66.7. What a rival should know: the clients are in a transition to Wallaroo Media, and the domain still answers under the old name.
doing:
The positioning line, a Seattle integrated digital marketing agency founded in 1995 pitching growth by making brands weird, useful and significant online, decodes as a full service generalist with an SEO spine, and it is a past tense line: the homepage itself says parent Clearlink closed Portent in May 2024. The headline claim is a content case, content hubs for a reference publisher driving 3.3 million organic visits.

The sold mix as the record scores it: SEO 3, the lead line, heading its services navigation, guide library and case categories, with RealTruck organic growth featured on the homepage. Content & Digital PR 2, core, on content strategy and link building and digital PR pages plus content hub and content promotion cases. Paid Search 2, core, on a PPC service, small business PPC management and audit offers, and a full funnel PPC case. CRO, Creator & Influencer, Data & Measurement, Local, Paid Social, Programmatic & CTV and Web & Product score 1 each; AI search, AI automation, B2B, email and CRM and retail media score 0. Breadth is 10. The record lists no proprietary product and no partners.

Its AI posture is null: the record holds no AI service, claim or content, and both AI capabilities score 0, a date stamp for a closed agency.

The one dated move is the closure, 2024-05: closed by parent Clearlink, with Wallaroo Media taking on many clients and the portent.com domain. News, case studies beyond the client pages, and jobs are empty.

Pricing signals survive: it ran a budget focused small business line with packaged offers, PPC account setup, a PPC account audit and an SEO diagnostic report, though the Horus P5 read still returns unknown, no public pricing model. Conspicuously absent for an agency of its kind is now everything current: no ad, no post in 365 days, no hire, and a successor doing the serving.
clients:
The client type is mixed; the verticals listed are automotive, moving services, business communications, satellite TV, streaming media and reference publishing; the home markets are Seattle and Salt Lake City.

The record lists 5 clients, all on case studies, and 4 carry an observed need. Lakedale came for organic demand and content, N1 and N12, on a case titled SEO content strategy drive. Choice Mutual came for organic demand, N1, on content promotion creating a major increase in organic traffic. MagellanTV came for social and creators, N8, on influencer marketing boosting conversions. Enercare came for local and lead generation, N10, on leads soaring with cross team collaboration. RealTruck is the one name only: featured on the homepage for organic growth per the SEO evidence note, but coded N0 in the needs table, so its need is inferred from the SEO line, organic demand. The computed mix puts N1 at 0.444, N8 and N10 at 0.222 each and N12 at 0.111. No client is shared with another tracked agency.

The reference publisher behind the 3.3 million organic visits claim is not named in the record.

What the base needs next is a question the successor answers, not this record. The status note says Wallaroo Media now serves many former clients and Arvo Digital is suggested for organic work, so it is almost certain, with high confidence, that these five names are no longer buying from Portent, and likely, with low confidence, that some are still in transition. The Horus read says the mix was best placed for KJ8, human provenance becomes a distribution signal, and most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out, driven by SEO and Paid Search, a headwind; a closure is that judgment already landed.

openings:
The strongest opening is the closure itself: the record says Clearlink closed Portent in May 2024 and Wallaroo Media took on many clients and the domain, so it is very likely, with high confidence, that Lakedale, Choice Mutual, MagellanTV, Enercare and RealTruck have been moved to a successor they did not choose, and clients in a transition answer the phone. The falsifier is a Wallaroo Media record showing each of the five as a retained client with described work.

The computed contradictions are now evidence for the pitch: it sold paid search and ran no Google ads of its own, house integrity is 0, and the sitemap shows 0 URLs updated in 365 days against a 500+ URL blog library. A rival selling into its verticals leads with continuity and a live house.

The gap to lead with against the successor is the one computed for Portent: KJ6 exposure driven by SEO and Paid Search, no AI search line, P1 absent, and no measurement depth, P4 partial. An outcome priced SEO and content offer with an audited AI visibility number meets a book that last bought hours from a generalist, likely, with moderate confidence, at packaged small business prices.
